description: Capability for the capture overlay window, which since 2026-08-01 lives in its own process (`spool --overlay`, see src/overlay.rs). NO sql: permission on purpose (DESIGN_CAPTURE_HELPER_PROCESS §3.3): a second process running getDb() would rebuild the precondition of the 2026-05-29 data wipe, so its DB calls are proxied to the main window and a stray Database.load() must fail loudly here. core:default covers Tauri events + custom invoke commands.
